N-leaf-imports-solver.mechanism: A leaf module (store, notifier, debugger, legionella, setpoint helpers) reaches the solver and scipy through one misplaced symbol, so importing the leaf loads the optimizer (~400 ms in a fresh interpreter) and couples it to the solve
N-leaf-imports-solver.differs: I2 is a measured closure that diverges from the real dependency graph; here the graph itself is wrong (a production import edge into the solver), and the closure measures it faithfully

N-restore-race.mechanism: A restore applies persisted state after an await during which a writer changed the same state, so the stale snapshot overwrites the live write (or the write lands on an object the restore then replaces)
N-restore-race.differs: N-restart loses a user-set state because the setter persisted too late or not at all; here persistence is correct and the defect is restore-vs-writer ordering inside the load await

N-order-coupling.mechanism: Two sibling updaters consume one shared interval and the first closes it destructively, so correctness depends on call order that only a comment and a source-order test hold
N-order-coupling.differs: P2 is one fact decided twice by divergent predicates; here there is one predicate and one consumer starves the other through a shared, destructively-read state
